limits: The legend is fixed and the model was fitted for western Paraná. An area elsewhere can return a confident and wrong result. Hectares are pixel counts, uncorrected for classification error.
MapBiomas is not field truth. Agreement is concordance with an annual map, often offset in time from the Sentinel-2 series.
Class 41 is a residual bucket. High overall accuracy against MapBiomas does not imply fine crop identity.
name: Random Forest
summary: Votes 300 decision trees over 80 spectro-temporal features per pixel, read from a Sentinel-2 series.

reads.label: Imagery
reads.value: Sentinel-2 L2A scenes in the period, under the cloud limit

reads.label: Features
reads.value: 80 per pixel: 14 descriptors each of NDVI, EVI and SAVI; mean, deviation, maximum and minimum of each band; NDVI on 22 dates

method.label: Split
method.value: 8 of the 80 features (√80) tried at each node

evaluation.method: Agreement with MapBiomas under spatial block cross-validation, and temporal coherence checked against the landowners' crop calendars on three western Paraná properties.
evaluation.source: Melo, Magalhães, Kolodziej and Kuhn, Automatic Land Cover Classification with Sentinel-2 and MapBiomas Time Series, SBrT 2026
